name.ja: 化学マスター方程式とGillespie SSA
name.en: Chemical master equation and Gillespie SSA

formula: \partial_t P(\boldsymbol n,t)=\sum_j\left[a_j(\boldsymbol n-\boldsymbol\nu_j)P(\boldsymbol n-\boldsymbol\nu_j,t)-a_j(\boldsymbol n)P(\boldsymbol n,t)\right]

note.ja: 整数分子数n、反応ジャンプνj、傾向関数ajの確率モデル。Gillespie SSAは軌道を標本化する解法で、反応網自体とは区別します。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：移入–死亡SSA：有限時刻の厳密分布
note.en: Integer molecule counts, reaction jumps νj and propensities aj; SSA samples paths of this continuous-time Markov model. The 1977 paper is a foundational SSA reference, not a priority claim for all master equations. SSA is a solver; the reaction network is the model. A seed documents a trajectory, not an ensemble validation. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Immigration–death SSA: exact transient laws

title.ja: 移入–死亡SSA：有限時刻の厳密分布

assumptions.ja: 移入率6、粒子ごとの死亡率1、観測時刻0/0.5/2/4。初期値0・5・名目上の定常Poisson(6)を各2seed、各記録2,048軌跡で比較します。粒子数は非負整数、時間単位を固定し、N=0では死亡propensityが零になります。
assumptions.en: Use immigration6, per-particle death1 and observations0/0.5/2/4. Compare initial0,5 and nominal stationary Poisson(6), two seeds each and2,048paths per record. Integer particle counts and a fixed time unit; death rate 1 per particle and immigration rate 6. Nonnegative integer counts; death propensity vanishes at N=0.

note.ja: 有限時間の決定論的初期状態を定常分布とは呼びません。区間の保証は理想IID法則の参照に限り、PRNG・対数演算を含むソフトウェア全体の被覆率保証や単一軌跡の代表性を主張しません。
note.en: Finite deterministic-start transients are not stationary. Interval qualification concerns the idealIID reference law, without a whole-software PRNG/logarithm coverage guarantee or a claim that one path represents the ensemble.

reference_note.ja: Binomial＋Poissonの厳密過渡法則を、80/120桁の有向区間・尾部上界で照合。20個のDKW目標と20個の厳密和平均目標を名目union bound0.01にまとめ、分散の5SE目標は別に残します。
reference_note.en: Qualify exact Binomial-plus-Poisson transients with directed80/120digit intervals and tail bounds. Combine20DKW and20exact-sum mean goals under nominal union bound0.01; retain five-SE variance goals separately.
